sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责为《纽约时报》的每日简报 Dealbook 报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会上，现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 我们将对部分访谈进行直播，任何人都可以于 11 月

sentences.en: 18th.
sentences.zh: 18日在 nytimes.com 免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序来观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Bilbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·比尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Last night, after a 20-year war that claimed more than 170,000 lives, cost over $2 trillion and failed to defeat the Taliban,
sentences.zh: 昨晚，在经历了长达 20 年、夺走 17 万多条生命、耗资超过 2 万亿美元且未能击败塔利班的战争后，

sentences.en: the United States completed its withdrawal from Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 美国完成了从阿富汗的撤军。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Eric Schmidt, about the final hours of the American occupation.
sentences.zh: 我与同事埃里克·施密特就美国占领阿富汗的最后几个小时进行了交流。

sentences.en: Tuesday, August 31St. Eric, we are talking to you at 6.45 on Monday night.
sentences.zh: 8月31日，星期二。埃里克，我们是在周一晚上 6 点 45 分与你对话的。

sentences.en: A lot has just happened in Kabul.
sentences.zh: 喀布尔刚刚发生了很多事情。

sentences.en: And I wanted to start by asking you to describe the last few hours there.
sentences.zh: 我想先请你描述一下那里过去的几个小时。

sentences.en: So in the last few hours, the last five American military planes carrying the last American troops
sentences.zh: 所以在过去的几个小时里，载着阿富汗最后一批美军的

sentences.en: in Afghanistan, including the general and top diplomat in the United States, left Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 最后五架美国军机——其中包括美国的将领和顶级外交官——离开了阿富汗。

sentences.en: The last of the troops were loaded on to these planes.
sentences.zh: 最后一批部队被登上了这些飞机。

sentences.en: And then shortly before midnight, these gray C-17 transport jets, one by one, took turns speeding down the single runway
sentences.zh: 接着，就在午夜之前，这些灰色的 C-17 运输机一架接一架，轮流在单条跑道上疾驰

sentences.en: and took off under the blanket of darkness into the Afghan sky.
sentences.zh: 在夜幕的掩护下腾空而起，飞入阿富汗的天空。

sentences.en: And on the streets of Kabul, there was celebratory gunfire from Taliban fighters celebrating
sentences.zh: 在喀布尔的街头上，塔利班武装分子鸣枪庆祝，庆祝

sentences.en: the departure of the last American troops who they had been fighting for 20 years in their country.
sentences.zh: 最后一批美军的撤离，这些美军是他们在国内与之战斗了 20 年的对手。

sentences.en: The final victory of their forever war.
sentences.zh: 他们永无止境的战争的最终胜利。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: I'm going to turn the podium over to General Frank McKenzie, commander of U.S.
sentences.zh: 我把讲台交给美国

sentences.en: Central Command.
sentences.zh: 中央司令部司令弗兰克·麦肯齐将军。

sentences.en: He'll have some opening comments.
sentences.zh: 他将作开场发言。

sentences.en: And shortly after that, the overall commander, General Frank McKenzie, said,
sentences.zh: 不久之后，最高指挥官弗兰克·麦肯齐将军表示：

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: I'm here to announce the completion of our withdrawal from Afghanistan and the end of the military mission to evacuate American citizens.
sentences.zh: 我在此宣布完成从阿富汗的撤军，以及撤离美国公民的军事任务的结束。

sentences.en: That the evacuation operations had closed.
sentences.zh: 撤离行动已经结束。

sentences.en: Tonight's withdrawal signifies both the end of the military component of the evacuation,
sentences.zh: 今晚的撤离既标志着撤离行动军事部分的结束，

sentences.en: but also the end of the nearly 20-year mission that began in Afghanistan shortly after September 11th, 2001.
sentences.zh: 也标志着始于 2001 年 9 月 11 日之后不久、持续了近 20 年的阿富汗使命的终结。

sentences.en: That was the end, essentially, of a 20-year war in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 这基本上标志着长达 20 年的阿富汗战争的结束。

sentences.en: It's been a long day.
sentences.zh: 这是漫长的一天。

sentences.en: The operation's gone smoothly so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，行动进行得很顺利。

sentences.en: And I just look forward to recovering the force completely, getting everybody home.
sentences.zh: 我只期待全面收回部队，让每个人都回家。

sentences.en: Thank you, General.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，将军。

sentences.en: Thanks for your time.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you all.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: Have a nice afternoon.
sentences.zh: 祝大家下午愉快。

sentences.en: It's such an interesting moment, Eric.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的时刻，埃里克。

sentences.en: It's both historic and also anticlimactic, because it feels like we have been building up to this moment.
sentences.zh: 它既具有历史意义，又有些虎头蛇尾，因为感觉我们一直在为这一刻做铺垫。

sentences.en: And when it came, it happened under the cover of darkness very quietly and ahead of schedule by nearly a full day before that August 31st deadline, right?
sentences.zh: 而当它到来时，却在夜幕的掩护下非常安静地发生了，并且比 8 月 31 日的最后期限提前了将近整整一天，对吗？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that was all for a reason, for several reasons, actually.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是有原因的，实际上有几个原因。

sentences.en: There were some concerns about weather Monday and Tuesday that could delay the final flight and postpone the deadline.
sentences.zh: 人们担心周一和周二的天气可能会延迟最后一次飞行并推迟最后期限。

sentences.en: There were concerns about trying to get out in darkness.
sentences.zh: 人们担心在黑暗中撤离的问题。

sentences.en: So they wanted to start Monday evening and use whatever time they had as a cushion in case the plane broke down or something like that.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们希望在周一晚上开始，并利用他们拥有的任何时间作为缓冲，以防飞机抛锚或发生类似情况。

sentences.en: There were concerns that the same crowds that overwhelmed the airport in those early days, after the first evacuation flights were taking off, would rush the tarmac again.
sentences.zh: 人们担心，在第一批撤离航班起飞后的头几天里挤爆机场的那些人群会再次冲向停机坪。

sentences.en: And then finally, there was a very real concern that ISIS-K, the Islamic State branch that had carried out the attack last week
sentences.zh: 最后，还有一个非常真实的担忧，即伊斯兰国呼罗珊分支（ISIS-K）——曾在上周发动了

sentences.en: that killed 13 service members, would try once again in these final hours.
sentences.zh: 导致 13 名军人身亡的袭击的那个伊斯兰国分支——会在最后的这几个小时里再次发动袭击。

sentences.en: So this was all an effort by the military to both honor their promise to get out and take in as many Americans and Afghan allies with them,
sentences.zh: 因此，军方作出这一切努力，既是为了兑现他们撤离并尽可能多地带走美国人及阿富汗盟友的承诺，

sentences.en: but to get out with the last forces getting out safely.
sentences.zh: 也是为了确保最后一批部队能够安全撤出。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And all those pressures must have been very meaningful for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 为了放弃截止日期前那些宝贵的最后几小时，美国必然承受了巨大的压力，

sentences.en: to have given up those precious final hours before the deadline, hours that I imagine mattered a great deal to the evacuation operation.
sentences.zh: 我想象这些小时对撤离行动至关重要。

sentences.en: And of all the pressures that you just mentioned, it feels like the most urgent one was terrorism.
sentences.zh: 在你刚提到的所有压力中，最紧迫的似乎是恐怖主义。

sentences.en: So can you catch us up on how that terror threat evolved over the past few days since the terror attack on the airport that killed dozens of Afghan civilians and those 13 U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，你能为我们梳理一下，自上周发生导致数十名阿富汗平民和 13 名美

sentences.en: service members?
sentences.zh: 军士兵丧生的机场恐袭以来，恐怖威胁是如何演变的吗？

sentences.en: Well, since the attack last week on the airport, there's been kind of a cat and mouse game going on between ISIS-K,
sentences.zh: 好的，自上周机场遭遇袭击以来，ISIS-K——

sentences.en: which is this branch of the Islamic State made up of disaffected Taliban, and the United States military.
sentences.zh: 这个由对塔利班不满的人组成的伊斯兰国分支——与美军之间一直在进行某种猫鼠游戏。

sentences.en: With only a few days left before the August 31st deadline, both sides knew that the airport was this remarkably tantalizing target
sentences.zh: 距离 8 月 31 日的最后期限只剩几天时间，双方都清楚机场对恐怖分子来说是一个极具诱惑的目标，

sentences.en: for the terrorists to strike, both because of the American military presence there, but also the large crowds of Afghan civilians.
sentences.zh: 这不仅因为那里有美军驻扎，还因为有大量的阿富汗平民聚集。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And since the attack on the airport, the United States has carried out two drone strikes.
sentences.zh: 自机场遭袭以来，美国已经实施了两次无人机空袭。

sentences.en: The first was carried out in eastern Afghanistan against two ISIS-K senior planners, who military officials say were actually planning future attacks.
sentences.zh: 第一次空袭在阿富汗东部实施，目标是两名 ISIS-K 的高级策划者，军方官员称他们当时正在策划未来的袭击。

sentences.en: The second drone strike was carried out on Sunday against a vehicle in Kabul, about two miles from the airport,
sentences.zh: 第二次无人机空袭于周日在喀布尔一辆距离机场约两英里的汽车上实施，

sentences.en: that the military says was filled with explosives, either explosive vests to be used by suicide bombers,
sentences.zh: 军方称车内装满了爆炸物，可能是供自杀式袭击者使用的炸弹背心，

sentences.en: like the one that detonated outside the gates last week, or just explosives that could be detonated as a car bomb.
sentences.zh: 就像上周在大门外引爆的那种，或者是可以作为汽车炸弹引爆的炸药。

sentences.en: And of course, there's a controversy over whether they made the correct strike.
sentences.zh: 当然，关于他们是否实施了正确的打击，目前存在争议。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, we've now reported, our colleagues on the ground have interviewed family members at the scene,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们现在的报道显示，我们在现场的同事采访了家属，

sentences.en: who say the driver of that car was not an ISIS member, he was an engineer, had nothing to do with the terrorist group,
sentences.zh: 他们称那辆车的司机不是 ISIS 成员，而是一名工程师，与该恐怖组织没有任何关系，

sentences.en: and that the strike actually killed 10 people altogether, including several children that were killed by the blast or by flying glass or other debris.
sentences.zh: 而且这次空袭实际上总共造成了 10 人死亡，其中包括几名因爆炸、飞溅的玻璃或其他碎片而丧生的儿童。

sentences.en: The military insists this was indeed an ISIS target.
sentences.zh: 军方坚称这确实是一个 ISIS 的目标。

sentences.en: They won't say publicly how they know this, but sources tell me they've got imagery from drones and other intelligence sources
sentences.zh: 他们不会公开说明他们是如何得知这一点的，但消息人士告诉我，他们掌握了来自无人机和其他情报来源的影像资料，

sentences.en: that show two men putting explosives into the back of this white Toyota Corolla, and they're tracking this car in fear it could be a major car bomb.
sentences.zh: 显示有两名男子将爆炸物放入这辆白色丰田卡罗拉的后备箱中，他们一直在追踪这辆车，生怕它成为一枚重型汽车炸弹。

sentences.en: And then just this morning, on Monday morning, there were five rockets that were launched at the airport.
sentences.zh: 就在今天早上，即周一早上，有五枚火箭弹向机场发射。

sentences.en: Three of them went awry and fell outside the perimeter, but the U.S.
sentences.zh: 其中三枚偏离了轨道，落在了警戒线外，但美军在机场的反火箭系统

sentences.en: counter-rocket system at the airport shot two of them down.
sentences.zh: 击落了其中的两枚。

sentences.en: So the threat was quite real and quite serious, as Pentagon officials say, right up until the end.
sentences.zh: 因此，正如五角大楼官员所说，直到最后时刻，这种威胁都非常真实且非常严重。

sentences.en: Literally, as the final troops were getting ready and preparing to fly out in the hours ahead of their departure,
sentences.zh: 就在最后一批部队准备在离开前的几个小时内登机飞离之际，

sentences.en: ISIS-K was launching attacks on the airfield.
sentences.zh: ISIS-K 正在对机场发动袭击。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So when we think about why the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们思考为什么美国

sentences.en: would be eager to get out well before that deadline, we should probably realize that every hour that American soldiers shaved off that deadline
sentences.zh: 急于在截止日期前很早就撤离时，我们大概应该意识到，美军从截止日期中削减的每一个小时，

sentences.en: was an hour in which civilians and U.S.
sentences.zh: 都是平民和美

sentences.en: soldiers were not going to be targets of suicide bombs or rockets at that airport.
sentences.zh: 军士兵不会成为该机场自杀式炸弹或火箭弹袭击目标的宝贵时间。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think that weighed heavily on the minds of commanders.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对指挥官们的决策产生了重大影响。

sentences.en: But for every hour they shaved off to protect American forces was one fewer hour that they could use to evacuate people out of the airport.
sentences.zh: 但为了保护美军而削减的每一个小时，都是他们无法用来从机场疏散人员的一个小时。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so it was a balancing act for commanders.
sentences.zh: 因此，这对指挥官来说是一种平衡的艺术。

sentences.en: Wayne, could they get one last batch of people out, whether they be Americans or Afghans?
sentences.zh: 韦恩，他们还能运走最后一批人吗，无论是美国人还是阿富汗人？

sentences.en: Could they get one last batch through the gates that were increasingly being locked up before they said, that's it?
sentences.zh: 在他们宣布“就到这里”之前，他们还能让最后一批人穿过那些正日益被锁上的大门吗？

sentences.en: And the last flights had to be reserved for American troops to get out and get out quickly.
sentences.zh: 而最后的航班必须留给美军，以便他们迅速撤离。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序，并获得 30 天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Eric, now that the United States military and its diplomats have left Kabul, that last flight is gone,
sentences.zh: 那么，埃里克，既然美军及其外交官已经离开喀布尔，最后一架航班也已离开，

sentences.en: I have to imagine that the evacuation operation that we have been talking about with you and our colleagues now for days is over as well.
sentences.zh: 我想我们这些天来一直与你和我们的同事讨论的撤离行动也已经结束了。

sentences.en: Is that correct?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Well, it is and it isn't.
sentences.zh: 嗯，既是也不是。

sentences.en: Certainly, the massive evacuation that we've seen involving fleets of American and other allied aircraft carrying hundreds, if not thousands, of people to safety is over.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们所看到的、涉及大批美国及盟友飞机将成百上千甚至数千人运送到安全地带的大规模撤离已经结束了。

sentences.en: But the State Department, the Defense Department insists there will still be ways for American citizens who remain in Afghanistan, as well as Afghan allies, to get out.
sentences.zh: 但国务院和国防部坚称，对于滞留在阿富汗的美国公民以及阿富汗盟友来说，仍然会有离开的途径。

sentences.en: How that will take place, will they be able to get out on commercial flights, chartered flights?
sentences.zh: 这会如何进行呢？他们能乘坐商业航班或包机离开吗？

sentences.en: Will they be able to get out over land routes, make their way across the border,
sentences.zh: 他们能够通过陆路路线离开、穿越边境吗？

sentences.en: particularly those former Afghan military and intelligence officers who are being hunted by the Taliban?
sentences.zh: 尤其是那些正遭到塔利班搜捕的前阿富汗军警官兵？

sentences.en: Will they be able to get out some way?
sentences.zh: 他们能以某种方式离开吗？

sentences.en: This is still very much an open question.
sentences.zh: 这仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: And how this will all work will, in large part, perhaps rest on this fleeting cooperation between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这一切将如何运作，在很大程度上可能取决于美国与塔利班之间这种短暂的合作，

sentences.en: and the Taliban to provide safe passage for those who want to leave the country.
sentences.zh: 以为那些想要离开这个国家的人提供安全通道。

sentences.en: Well, should those left behind be skeptical or should they believe that U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，留在当地的人是该保持怀疑，还是应该相信美国的说法——

sentences.en: claim that if you're not out today, there's still a pathway out after today from Kabul to Europe or the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 如果你今天没能离开，从今天起仍然有一条从喀布尔通往欧洲或美国的离开途径？

sentences.en: Well, I think they have to be somewhat skeptical because this seemed to be the main ticket out, as dangerous as it was,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他们必须保持一定的怀疑态度，因为这似乎是主要的出路，尽管极其危险，

sentences.en: making your way past Taliban checkpoints and braving the threat of ISIS-K bombings and just getting through to the gates and then getting on the airfield and waiting hours and hours to get a flight out.
sentences.zh: 你需要穿过塔利班的检查站，冒着 ISIS-K 轰炸的威胁，硬闯过大门，然后登上飞机场，等待数小时才能搭乘航班离开。

sentences.en: Now the path is much murkier how you would get out, either how do you fly out, you know, who's going to be in charge of that, who's going to be in charge of the airport,
sentences.zh: 现在，如何离开的路径要模糊得多，无论是你将如何乘机离开，你知道，谁将负责此事，谁将负责机场，

sentences.en: just in terms of an operating airport that would be secure and that people can make their way to safely and get out that way.
sentences.zh: 仅仅从一个安全且人们可以安全前往并以此离开的运营机场的角度来看。

sentences.en: There are a lot of questions about how this is going to work from here on in for any American citizens, much less Afghan allies of this effort who want to get out now.
sentences.zh: 对于任何想要离开的美国公民，更不用说那些希望现在就离开的此次行动的阿富汗盟友来说，关于这一切将如何运作，存在着诸多疑问。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So knowing that a certain phase of the evacuation, as you just said,
sentences.zh: 因此，既然知道撤离的某个阶段——正如你刚才所说——

sentences.en: the easier and larger scale phase of it is over and that all efforts to get out now are going to be infinitely harder,
sentences.zh: 那种更轻松、规模更大的阶段已经结束，现在所有撤离的努力都将变得无比艰难，

sentences.en: let's talk for a moment about who has been evacuated and who has not been, starting with who has been evacuated.
sentences.zh: 让我们花点时间谈谈谁已经被疏散，谁还没有，从已经疏散的人开始。

sentences.en: Well, we're talking about a total of over 120,000 people that have been evacuated, roughly 6,000 American citizens, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们指的是总共有超过 12 万人被疏散，美国

sentences.en: government said today, who wanted to leave, have been able to be evacuated.
sentences.zh: 政府今天表示，大约有 6000 名希望离开的美国公民已经成功撤离。

sentences.en: The vast majority of the rest are Afghans,
sentences.zh: 其余绝大多数是阿富汗人，

sentences.en: some of these special interest visa Afghans who spent years working alongside American troops or diplomats in Afghanistan or who provided other services.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是特别签证阿富汗人，他们在阿富汗与美军或外交官并肩工作了多年，或者提供了其他服务。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But many, many more are left behind.
sentences.zh: 但是，还有许许多多的人被留在了后面。

sentences.en: How many?
sentences.zh: 有多少人？

sentences.en: Because what you just described is something on the order of 114,000 Afghan civilians.
sentences.zh: 因为你刚刚描述的数字大约是 11 万 4 千名阿富汗平民。

sentences.en: So how many were not evacuated?
sentences.zh: 那么有多少人没有被疏散？

sentences.en: Well, by some estimates, there were as many as 300,000 people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，据一些估计，多达 30 万人。

sentences.en: Again, largely Afghans of different categories who were seeking to get out, who for whatever reason, their paperwork wasn't completed, they couldn't pass through the checkpoints,
sentences.zh: 同样，主要是各种类别的阿富汗人，他们曾试图离开，但由于某种原因，他们的纸质文件没有办完，无法通过检查站，

sentences.en: or in the end, there just wasn't enough time to run the gauntlet and get onto the airfield and get on one of these last precious flights to safety.
sentences.zh: 或者最后根本没有足够的时间闯过重重关卡、登上机场并搭乘这些通往安全地带的珍贵航班。

sentences.en: General McKenzie said everybody who was inside the airport was on a plane by the end.
sentences.zh: 麦肯齐将军表示，到最后，所有在机场内部的人都上了飞机。

sentences.en: There was nobody left inside the airport stranded.
sentences.zh: 机场里面没有留下任何被困人员。

sentences.en: But there were plenty of people outside the wire who did not get a flight out.
sentences.zh: 但防线外有大量的人没有登上航班。

sentences.en: And he hinted at something that was interesting, Michael, in that he talked about the cooperation throughout these last two weeks between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，他还暗示了一件很有意思的事，他谈到在过去两周里，美国

sentences.en: military and the Taliban, erstwhile enemies who have actually been working pretty well, all things considered.
sentences.zh: 军方和塔利班——这些曾经的敌人——在综合考量下，其实一直合作得相当不错。

sentences.en: And he suggested that that cooperation may extend further into the future, even after the military's left,
sentences.zh: 他还表示，这种合作未来可能还会进一步延续，甚至在美军撤离之后也是如此，

sentences.en: to allow other American citizens who are still in the country now to get out by other means, which he didn't go into.
sentences.zh: 以便让目前仍滞留国内的其他美国公民通过他未详细说明的其他途径离开。

sentences.en: Well, what is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，美国与这个国家的

sentences.en: relationship to the country?
sentences.zh: 关系究竟是怎样的？

sentences.en: We have gone from occupying force for 20 years to what exactly?
sentences.zh: 我们从占据了20年的占领军变成了究竟什么身份？

sentences.en: How would you characterize what the relationship is right now?
sentences.zh: 你觉得目前的双边关系到底该如何定性？

sentences.en: So it's right now kind of a murky, fluid situation.
sentences.zh: 所以目前这是一个有点模糊、多变的情况。

sentences.en: On Monday night, Secretary of State Tony Blinken said that the core diplomatic staff had left, that essentially the American diplomatic presence in Afghanistan had closed for good.
sentences.zh: 周一晚上，国务卿安东尼·布林肯表示，核心外交人员已经撤离，这意味着美国在阿富汗的外交存在基本上彻底关闭了。

sentences.en: And the diplomatic presence that will engage with Afghanistan had moved to Doha, Qatar.
sentences.zh: 而将与阿富汗进行接触的外交阵地已转移至卡塔尔多哈。

sentences.en: And from there, U.S.
sentences.zh: 从那里开始，美国

sentences.en: will conduct some kind of relations with the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 将与塔利班保持某种形式的关系。

sentences.en: But there really isn't a relationship right now.
sentences.zh: 但目前实际上并没有真正的关系。

sentences.en: It's kind of in limbo.
sentences.zh: 可以说是处于悬而未决的状态。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 这是为什么呢？

sentences.en: I mean, why, if we're already talking to the Taliban, you have described this cooperation as being pretty constructive.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为什么既然我们已经在和塔利班对话，你也将这种合作描述为相当具有建设性，

sentences.en: Why don't we have formal relations and why can't we keep some kind of embassy in Afghanistan?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们没有建立正式关系，为什么我们在阿富汗不能保留某种形式的大使馆？

sentences.en: Well, again, I think what we've been talking about is a very short-term accommodation these last couple of weeks to get safe passage for Americans and allied Afghans to get out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，再说一次，我认为我们一直在谈论的是过去几周内的一种极短期的权宜之计，目的是为了让美国人和同盟阿富汗人安全离开。

sentences.en: And this was basically accommodating the short-term self-interest of both the United States to get its people out,
sentences.zh: 这基本上是为了兼顾双方的短期切身利益，一方面美国要让其民众撤离，

sentences.en: but also for the Taliban to get the foreigners out and allow them to get on with the business of standing up their government.
sentences.zh: 另一方面塔利班也要让外国人离开，并允许他们继续着手建立自己的政府。

sentences.en: Now we're facing, you know, a much broader set of issues, whether to engage diplomatically long-term with the Taliban, whether to continue humanitarian assistance to the country,
sentences.zh: 现在我们面临的是，你知道的，范围大得多的一系列问题，包括是否与塔利班进行长期的外交接触、是否继续对该国提供人道主义援助、

sentences.en: whether to provide economic assistance and military assistance to these things.
sentences.zh: 是否提供经济援助和军事援助等等。

sentences.en: Now, the United States has already said it would continue humanitarian assistance for the people of Afghanistan,
sentences.zh: 目前，美国已经表示将继续向阿富汗人民提供人道主义援助，

sentences.en: but clearly economic aid and any kind of security assistance that was envisioned to an American-supported Afghan government is out of the question right now.
sentences.zh: 但很显然，经济援助以及任何原计划给予美国支持的阿富汗政府的安全援助，目前都是不可能的。

sentences.en: Can you help me understand that, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，你能帮我理解这一点吗？

sentences.en: Is the Taliban officially now an enemy of the United States as we leave?
sentences.zh: 在我们撤离之际，塔利班现在是否正式成为了美国的敌人？

sentences.en: Is that the definition of the relationship?
sentences.zh: 这就是双方关系的定义吗？

sentences.en: Is that the dynamic?
sentences.zh: 这就是目前的动态吗？

sentences.en: Well, I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不确定。

sentences.en: I'm not sure that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我不确定美国

sentences.en: government would want to classify the Taliban as the enemy right now.
sentences.zh: 政府现在愿意把塔利班归类为敌人。

sentences.en: Certainly they have been the enemy in the past when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当然，过去美国

sentences.en: was fighting the force.
sentences.zh: 与这支武装作战时，他们确实是敌人。

sentences.en: But now they control this country.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们控制了这个国家。

sentences.en: They control a country that's still significant, has some significant interests in the United States,
sentences.zh: 他们控制了一个依然很重要的国家，并且与美国有着一些重大的利益交集，

sentences.en: principally the fact that there are still many American citizens inside the country,
sentences.zh: 最主要的是国内仍然有许多美国公民，

sentences.en: and there's still very much a concern of terrorist groups like al-Qaeda and ISIS-K that could regroup there.
sentences.zh: 并且人们依然非常担心基地组织和伊斯兰国呼罗珊省（ISIS-K）等可能在那里重新集结的恐怖组织。

sentences.en: And so to the point where if the Taliban is willing to engage with the United States and help prevent some of these groups, which, like with al-Qaeda, it has long-standing ties,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果塔利班愿意与美国接触并协助阻止其中某些组织——就像它与基地组织长期存在联系的那样——

sentences.en: to prevent them from regrouping, to carry out attacks against the United States, that would be something the United States would want to work on.
sentences.zh: 阻止它们重新集结以对美国发动袭击，这将是美国愿意共同努力的方向。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So to the degree that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，在美方

sentences.en: will recognize the Taliban as a government, perhaps work with it, perhaps someday in the future have a real diplomatic relationship with it,
sentences.zh: 承认塔利班为政府、或许与其合作、或许在未来某天与其建立真正外交关系的程度上，

sentences.en: it wants the Taliban to earn that through cooperation and good deeds that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国希望塔利班通过美方所期望的合作与善举来赢得这一切。

sentences.en: wants from the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为美国官员已经反复说过这一点。

sentences.en: And I think American officials have said this over and over.
sentences.zh: 他们将根据这个新上台的塔利班政权的行为、它的所作所为，而不是单看它说了什么来对其进行判断。

sentences.en: They'll judge this Taliban regime coming in by its behavior, by what it does, not necessarily by what it says.
sentences.zh: 并且它将在此基础上逐步推进一些非常短期的事情，首先就是努力让美国公民撤离。

sentences.en: And it will build on things, very short-term things, like, first of all, trying to get American citizens out.
sentences.zh: 然后在此基础上落实其不容许基地组织或ISIS-K重新集结并对美国发动袭击的承诺。

sentences.en: Then it will build on just its pledge not to allow al-Qaeda or ISIS-K to regroup and be able to carry out attacks against the United States.
sentences.zh: 所以我想你会看到一些构建模块，它们会用来，你知道的，建立或摧毁对这段关系的信任。

sentences.en: So I think you'll see some building blocks that would, you know, build confidence or not in this relationship.
sentences.zh: 我想在此基础上，你知道的，我们将拭目以待未来外交关系如何进一步展开。

sentences.en: And I think based on that, you know, we'll see how further diplomatic relations are extended.
sentences.zh: 我认为这将是一个漫长的过程，我们要说的是几个月，甚至几年，类似的事情才会发生。

sentences.en: I think this will be over a long period of time, and we're talking months, if not years, before something like this happens.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们可能会看到令人鼓舞的步骤，就像我们刚刚在过去几周看到的那样，当时双方在一些非常具体的有限目标上达成了共识。

sentences.en: And, you know, we could see encouraging steps like we've seen just in the last few weeks when both sides could agree on some very narrow goals.
sentences.zh: 但未来绝对也可能会存在一些领域，比如塔利班对女性的对待方式，

sentences.en: But there definitely could be areas in the future, the Taliban's treatment of women,
sentences.zh: 或者他们是否允许基地组织大举回流并再次设立训练营。

sentences.en: whether or not they do allow al-Qaeda to come back in large numbers and have training camps again.
sentences.zh: 这些显然将成为双方进一步发展外交关系的极其严重的障碍。

sentences.en: These obviously would be very serious obstacles to any further diplomatic relations between the two.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你刚才暗示了一点，我想更深入地了解，那就是我们以及我们的军方如何应对阿富汗持续存在的恐怖主义威胁。

sentences.en: Well, you just hinted at something that I want to better understand, which is how we and our military engage with the ongoing threat of terrorism in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 一直以来的恐惧，即将美国

sentences.en: The fear all along, the fear that brought the U.S.
sentences.zh: 带到阿富汗的恐惧，就是这里会成为可能影响美国的恐怖主义的发源地。

sentences.en: to Afghanistan was that it would be the hosting ground for terrorism that could affect the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们已经撤离，我们是否仍觉得自己有义务在阿富汗国内打击恐怖主义？

sentences.en: And now that we've left, do we still see ourselves as having an obligation to fight terrorism inside Afghanistan?
sentences.zh: 嗯，拜登总统已经说得很清楚了，对阿富汗的承诺中

sentences.en: Well, President Biden has made that very clear, that the one area where the commitment to Afghanistan
sentences.zh: 坚定不移的一个领域，就是确保这里绝不再成为那些企图对美国发动打击的恐怖分子的避难所。

sentences.en: will be unwavering is to make sure that it never can be a sanctuary again for terrorists who would carry out strikes against the United States.
sentences.zh: 他设想实现这一点的方式是派遣美国的无人机，从几千英里之外的波斯湾起飞，

sentences.en: And the way he envisions that taking place is by having American drones flying from thousands of miles away
sentences.zh: 你知道的，监视着阿富汗，并利用我们的监控技术，试图发现国内正在萌芽的基地组织或“伊斯兰国”的阴谋或恐怖细胞，

sentences.en: in the Persian Gulf, you know, watching over Afghanistan and our surveillance technology, trying to pick up on budding plots or cells of al-Qaeda or ISIS in the country
sentences.zh: 防范它们针对美国人或美国本土的阴谋。

sentences.en: that could be plotting against Americans or the American homeland.
sentences.zh: 这将是美国在不久的将来对阿富汗的核心承诺，即防止其再次成为这种安全避难所。

sentences.en: This will be the commitment, the main commitment the United States has to Afghanistan in the immediate future is to prevent it from becoming this safe haven again.
sentences.zh: 但如果是仅仅威胁阿富汗人民、而不威胁美国的恐怖主义呢？

sentences.en: But what if it's terrorism that just threatens the people of Afghanistan, not the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 嗯，遗憾的是，我认为尽管美国

sentences.en: Well, sadly, I think that will be something while the U.S.
sentences.zh: 会对此予以谴责，而且我认为极有可能这些相互对立的恐怖组织——例如基地组织和ISIS-K在同一个国家里——

sentences.en: will condemn that, and I think there's a very strong likelihood that these rival terrorist groups, al-Qaeda and ISIS-K, for instance, in the same country,
sentences.zh: 可能会导致进一步的流血事件。

sentences.en: that it could be further bloodshed.
sentences.zh: 但只要它不威胁美国人或美国的利益，美国就不一定会介入其中。

sentences.en: But so long as it does not threaten Americans or American interests, the United States is not necessarily going to get involved in that.
sentences.zh: 那么，埃里克，你是自2001年底事件开始以来少数几个一直报道美国与阿富汗故事的人之一。

sentences.en: So, Eric, you're one of the few people who have been covering the story of the United States and Afghanistan since it began in late 2001.
sentences.zh: 当美国

sentences.en: You were actually a Times military correspondent when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 进攻并入侵阿富汗时，你实际上是《泰晤士报》的军事记者。

sentences.en: attacked and invaded Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 我今晚回去查阅了相关资料，简直不敢相信你报道这个故事的时间有这么长。

sentences.en: I went back and researched this tonight and couldn't believe just how long you have covered this story.
sentences.zh: 你在战争期间曾作为记者前往阿富汗，而现在你又在这里报道它的最后时刻。

sentences.en: You've traveled to Afghanistan as a reporter during the war, and now here you are covering the final hours of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道你今晚有什么感想。

sentences.en: And so I wonder what you are thinking about this evening.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，显然我内心有一部分是难过的。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, it's obviously part of me is sad.
sentences.zh: 为阿富汗人民感到难过，也为任务以这种混乱、狂热的方式结束而难过，

sentences.en: It's kind of sad for the people of Afghanistan and sad that the mission ended this way, in this kind of chaotic, frenzied way,
sentences.zh: 伴随着13名美国军人和100多名阿富汗人的死亡。

sentences.en: with the death of 13 American service members and more than 100 Afghans.
sentences.zh: 所以这当然是我现在脑海中最深刻的想法。

sentences.en: So that's certainly foremost in my mind now.
sentences.zh: 但我想当我审视这一切时，我认为海外的大规模军事干预时代显然已经结束了。

sentences.en: But I think when I look at this, I think the era of these large military interventions overseas is clearly over.
sentences.zh: 但打击恐怖主义的时代并没有结束。

sentences.en: But the era of fighting terrorism is not.
sentences.zh: 我看到这种对抗将持续非常、非常长的时间。

sentences.en: That I see lasting for a long, long time.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅局限于一两个国家，令人遗憾的是，这些不同的恐怖组织——基地组织和“伊斯兰国”，

sentences.en: And rather than it having just be in one or two countries, sadly, these different terrorist organizations, al-Qaeda and ISIS,
sentences.zh: 成功地利用了世界各个角落的本土积怨，并招募武装分子为他们的事业摇旗呐喊。

sentences.en: have successfully exploited local grievances in various corners of the world and enlisted fighters to rally to their cause.
sentences.zh: 他们建立了自己的分支机构，从西非的萨赫勒到西奈半岛、中亚、太平洋再到东南亚。

sentences.en: And they've created affiliates from the Sahel in West Africa, to the Sinai, to Central Asia, to the Pacific, to Southeast Asia.

sentences.en: And so I think while these large military occupations and all the destruction that they wrought and all the pain and costs they inflicted, those may be over,
sentences.zh: 但尚未结束的是这些分散在世界各地的小型、零散的恐怖细胞，以及它们继续向欧洲和美国蔓延的威胁。

sentences.en: what isn't done are these small, diffuse terrorist cells that are spread all over the world and the threat that they could spread into Europe and the United States still.

sentences.en: Not on a grand scale, but lethal enough to kill Americans.
sentences.zh: 这里三两个，那里三两个。

sentences.en: A handful here, a handful there.
sentences.zh: 这才是美国真正面临的问题。

sentences.en: And that's really the problem that the United States has faced.
sentences.zh: 你该如何彻底根除它？

sentences.en: How do you stamp that out?
sentences.zh: 这将是真正的挑战。

sentences.en: That's going to be the real challenge.
sentences.zh: 好的，埃里克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Well, Eric, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我们对此表示感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to another day.
sentences.zh: 我能告诉你的是，过去几天对我们的州来说并不好过。

sentences.en: What I can tell you is that the last couple of days have not been good for our state.
sentences.zh: 而且在接下来的几天和几周里，情况也不会轻松。

sentences.en: And for the next several days and weeks, they will not be easy either.
sentences.zh: 艾达飓风导致路易斯安那州超过一百万人断电，切断了30多万人的供水，

sentences.en: Hurricane Ida has left more than one million people across Louisiana without electricity, cut off the water supply to more than 300,000,
sentences.zh: 并迫使大约2000人转移到避难所。

sentences.en: and forced some 2,000 to relocate to shelters.
sentences.zh: 但官员表示，目前这场风暴造成的死亡人数仍然较低，为三人。

sentences.en: But so far, officials said, the death toll from the storm remains low, at three people.
sentences.zh: 而在2005年卡特里娜飓风之后重建的庞大堤坝系统，

sentences.en: And the vast system of levees, rebuilt after Hurricane Katrina in 2005,
sentences.zh: 似乎成功地保护了新奥尔良市免受毁灭性洪水的侵袭。

sentences.en: appeared to succeed in protecting the city of New Orleans from catastrophic flooding.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么值得庆幸的——虽然今天很难找到这样的一面——那就是我们的堤坝系统确实表现得极其出色。

sentences.en: If there is a silver lining, and today it's kind of hard to see one, it is that our levee systems really did perform extremely well.
sentences.zh: 然而，风暴造成的全面破坏程度仍然未知，大规模的搜救行动仍在进行中。

sentences.en: However, the full extent of the storm's damage remains unknown, and a major search and rescue operation is still underway.
